tag.c.leaf_carpets.description: A decorative carpet made of leaves! It can be harvested by hand and has no collision box.
tag.c.horse_armor.description: An item that can be equipped on your Horse to protect them from damage.
tag.quark.hedges.description: Hedges made with an overworld log and the respective leaf type. They connect like fences, and have the same collision box.
item.amendments.dragon_charge.descriptio: An item that is used to spawn Dragon's Breath, by hand or when shot from a Dispenser.
tag.beams.beams.description: Can be placed at any angle & on any surface you want! R-Click to place the beam, L-Click to cancel placement.
item.chalk.chalk.description: Allows you to draw marks for easier navigation in caves or structures, or as decoration.
